scripts.desktop:build: vite build --config apps/studio/vite.config.ts && vite build --config packages/cli/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts --mode preload
scripts.desktop:dev: vite build --config packages/cli/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts && vite build --config apps/desktop/vite.config.ts --mode preload && electron apps/desktop --dev
scripts.dist: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --projectDir apps/desktop --win --publish never
scripts.release: npm run desktop:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --projectDir apps/desktop --win --publish always
